description: Create the CA with `puppetserver ca setup` (root + intermediate, 15-year lifetime) before the first service start. Skipped when a CA already exists.

subject_alt_names.description: Comma-separated DNS alt names to embed in the server certificate (--subject-alt-names)

certname.description: Certificate name for the server certificate (--certname); defaults to the certname in puppet.conf

ca_name.description: Common name for the intermediate CA certificate (--ca-name); defaults to 'Puppet CA: <fqdn>'
